dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES devotionals (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dimensions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_hex" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "emotions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES emotions (id), "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "triggers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "topics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dimensions (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "validation_passage" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("name_key", "dimension_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devotionals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "book_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter" INTEGER NOT NULL, "verse_start" INTEGER NULL, "verse_end" INTEGER NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "key_verse" TEXT NULL, "period_id" TEXT NULL, "empire_id" TEXT NULL, "region_id" TEXT NULL, "author" TEXT NULL, "approx_year" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devotional_topics" ("devotional_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES devotionals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "topic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("devotional_id", "topic_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "praxis_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "circumstance" TEXT NOT NULL, "intensity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("intensity" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "filter" TEXT NOT NULL, "foundation_detail" TEXT NULL, "passage" TEXT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "peace" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("peace" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "coherence" INTEGER NULL CHECK("coherence" BETWEEN 1 AND 10), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "praxis_emotions" ("praxis_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES praxis_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "emotion_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES emotions (id), PRIMARY KEY ("praxis_id", "emotion_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "praxis_triggers" ("praxis_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES praxis_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "trigger_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES triggers (id), PRIMARY KEY ("praxis_id", "trigger_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "praxis_topics" ("praxis_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES praxis_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "topic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("praxis_id", "topic_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "transcript" TEXT NOT NULL, "intent" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_topics" ("prayer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prayers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "topic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("prayer_id", "topic_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prayer_praxis_links" ("prayer_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES prayers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "praxis_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES praxis_entries (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("prayer_id", "praxis_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "beliefs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "proposition" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimension_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES dimensions (id), "devotional_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES devotionals (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "base_passage" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "belief_topics" ("belief_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beliefs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "topic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("belief_id", "topic_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "belief_evidence" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "belief_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beliefs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "passage" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "votes" INTEGER NULL, "prob_entail" REAL NULL, "prob_contra" REAL NULL, "model_version" TEXT NULL, "resolved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("resolved" IN (0, 1)), "confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("belief_id", "passage"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "action_beliefs" ("action_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "belief_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beliefs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "alignment" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NULL, "confirmed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("action_kind", "action_id", "belief_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_labels" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_gold" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_gold" IN (0, 1)), "correct" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "thought_patterns" ("action_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prototype_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "similarity" REAL NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "confirmed" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("confirmed" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("action_kind", "action_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "judge_feedback" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "judge_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "task" TEXT NOT NULL, "predicted" TEXT NOT NULL, "probability" REAL NOT NULL, "user_label" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX devotionals_date ON devotionals (date)
CREATE INDEX devotionals_book ON devotionals (book_code)
CREATE INDEX praxis_date ON praxis_entries (date)
CREATE INDEX attachments_owner ON attachments (owner_type, owner_id)
CREATE INDEX belief_evidence_belief ON belief_evidence (belief_id)
CREATE INDEX action_beliefs_belief ON action_beliefs (belief_id)
